$comment: Permissive SPDX ids accepted without review (plan §14.5). Anything else fails CI unless listed under exceptions with a reason.

geo-tz.reason: Code is MIT; bundled timezone-boundary data is ODbL (derived from OpenStreetMap). Attribution carried in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and the in-app footer. ODbL share-alike applies to the database, which we do not modify or redistribute.

@img/sharp-*.reason: Optional dependency of Next.js (next/image optimisation), never imported by LightMap code. The prebuilt libvips binary is LGPL-3.0; it is used unmodified, dynamically loaded as a native module on the server only, and never shipped to browsers. LGPL obligations (notice, unmodified upstream library) are met via THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Weak copyleft does not extend to LightMap's own code.
